prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent 4x adventure-game sprite, a faithful whole-frame redrawing of helicopter phase1990 from Sam & Max Hit the Road.
Input images: Image1 supplies ONLY the exact helicopter pose, silhouette, proportions, rotor phase and palette. Image2, the approved Sam character sheet, supplies the clean inked cartoon rendering style ONLY. Do not draw Sam.
Redraw the COMPLETE helicopter in image1 as a clean hand-inked cartoon sprite with continuous smooth sloping contours and coherent flat colour shapes, one shadow step and the original small highlights. Interpret the pixel clusters as their actual mechanical parts; do not trace the square pixel staircase, reproduce the raster grid or merely blur it. Make it look drawn like image2 at small native scale, not pixel art and not a photorealistic or 3D helicopter.
Keep exactly the source projection, rotor angle, proportions, every visible rotor segment, fuselage, tail pieces, skid struts, openings and small disconnected details. Preserve the same relationships and positions. Long silver-white rotor shapes extend upper-left and right from the same hub; the compact brown fuselage sits below, forest-green tail/underside and skids, dark-grey window and small pale blue highlights. Keep all original small features. Do not invent windows, rivets, insignia, equipment, panels, blur trails, motion arcs or new outlines around gaps. Use a thin controlled very dark contour consistent with the approved cartoon style, without expanding the silhouette.
Palette: retain the original deep warm brown/orange fuselage, forest-green shadow parts, grey/silver/white rotors, grey window, and tiny light-blue and gold marks in their source positions. No grey cast over the drawing, no extra texture, dithering, colour-band staircases, grain, soft gradients or changed lighting.
Composition: keep image1's complete 1024x1024 square canvas, original central placement, small object scale and ample empty margins; do not crop, zoom, enlarge or recenter the helicopter. The outer motif reference spans836x418 pixels before clean contour redrawing. Native target after whole-image fitting is304x152 plus transparent margin. All grey background in image1 becomes true transparent alpha, including openings. No floor, ground shadow, backdrop, text, labels, border or watermark. Return ONE complete helicopter with genuine smooth transparent antialiasing.
